cell-size.$description: Default code cell edge before applying control density.

cell-size-sm.$description: Small code cell edge before applying control density.

bg-image.$description: Optional image painted over the code cell fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Optional compositing filter behind a code cell.

disabled-fg.$description: Code character ink while the field is disabled.

active-border.$description: Focus outline around the active or selected cells.

error-border.$description: Code cell boundary after failed validation.

selection-bg.$description: Background of a selected code character.

selection-fg.$description: Ink of a selected code character.

touch-font-size.$description: Minimum native input text size on a coarse pointer.

blink-duration.$description: Duration of one code caret blink.
